ProductsPage.metaDescription: Smart corporate fleet, VIP mobility, flexible and short-term rental, and a green fleet: Novera Mobility products.
ProductsPage.title: Our fleet solutions
ProductsPage.intro: Four solutions for the pace of your business. If you are not sure which fits, our corporate team will point you in the right direction.
ProductsPage.ctaTitle: Get a quote for this solution
ProductsPage.ctaText: Share your fleet size and the period, and our corporate team will return with a tailored quote.

akilli-kurumsal-filo.title: Smart Corporate Fleet Rental
akilli-kurumsal-filo.concept: While we allocate your company a fleet of the latest models, we give you the central Admin Panel to manage the whole fleet as a gift.
akilli-kurumsal-filo.whatYouGet: A long-term rental fleet suited to your company's needs (saloon, SUV, commercial or hybrid).

points.title: Novera Admin Panel included
points.text: See which employee each car is assigned to, contract terms, invoices and HGS (toll) costs in one click.

points.title: Live GPS and telematics
points.text: Follow the speed, ignition status, route history and fuel consumption of the rented cars on a live map.
A company management interface that automates expense and fine tracking.

akilli-kurumsal-filo.tagline: A late-model fleet and the Admin Panel that runs it from one screen, together.
akilli-kurumsal-filo.idealFor: Companies with a fleet of 10 vehicles or more

highlights.title: A fleet that fits
highlights.text: Cars, SUVs, vans or hybrids, mixed as you need.

highlights.title: One screen to run it
highlights.text: Assignments, contracts, invoices and toll costs in one panel.

highlights.title: Live tracking
highlights.text: Speed, route and fuel data on a live map.

vip-mobilite.title: Executive and Premium Car Rental (VIP Mobility)
vip-mobilite.concept: A luxury-segment, fully equipped, priority mobility solution for senior company executives and corporate guests.
vip-mobilite.whatYouGet: E and F segment prestige cars (Audi, BMW, Mercedes and others), with optional VIP chauffeur support.

points.title: Priority mobile concierge
points.text: A VIP support line for the driver and the executive.

points.title: Fast transfer and chauffeur coordination
points.text: Greeting, route optimisation and flight tracking through a mobile interface.

vip-mobilite.tagline: Prestige cars and priority support for your executives and guests.

highlights.title: E and F segment
highlights.text: Fully equipped prestige cars such as Audi, BMW and Mercedes.

highlights.title: Chauffeur on request
highlights.text: VIP chauffeur support for meet-and-greet and transfers.

highlights.title: Priority concierge
highlights.text: A dedicated support line for drivers and executives.

esnek-kisa-donem.title: Flexible & Short-Term Car Rental (SMEs and Individuals)
esnek-kisa-donem.concept: No-commitment, fast-delivery rental for project-based work, urgent field needs or seasonal travel.
esnek-kisa-donem.whatYouGet: Latest-model cars by the day, week or month.

points.title: Novera Driver App
points.text: When you take the key, photograph any scratch or damage on your phone and keep a digital record.

points.title: In-app SOS button
points.text: If something goes wrong, send your location to the centre and call for help with one tap.

esnek-kisa-donem.tagline: By the day, week or month; hand the car back when the job is done.
esnek-kisa-donem.idealFor: SMEs, project teams and individual drivers

highlights.title: Flexible term
highlights.text: Rent by the day, week or month.

highlights.title: Fast delivery
highlights.text: A car the same day for urgent field work.

highlights.title: Digital handover
highlights.text: Damage records and handover report in the driver app.

yesil-filo.title: Green Fleet (Electric & Hybrid Car Rental)
yesil-filo.concept: A sustainable, new-generation fleet solution for companies that want to reduce their carbon footprint.
yesil-filo.whatYouGet: The most up-to-date electric and hybrid fleet.

points.text: Live battery health and charging station status through the panel, plus reporting of the carbon emissions saved for your company.

yesil-filo.tagline: Cut your carbon footprint measurably with an electric and hybrid fleet.

highlights.title: Electric and hybrid
highlights.text: A new-generation fleet of current models.

highlights.title: Battery and charging
highlights.text: Battery health and charging status in the panel.

highlights.title: Carbon report
highlights.text: The emission savings in periodic reports.

ProductsPage.helpText: Tell us how many vehicles, for how long and how you use them; our corporate team will choose the right solution with you.
